name: Ekon
summary: Pure black branding studio site set entirely in uppercase Switzer, with a preloader into a full-bleed image hero, a scroll-lit manifesto paragraph, a draggable project ticker and a numbered service ledger.

fonts.pairing: single family: Switzer 600 to 700 uppercase with -0.02 to -0.04em tracking for headings and labels, Switzer 500 sentence case for body, white at 50 to 100% opacity for hierarchy

signature: preloader wordmark that hands over to a hero image settling from 1.2x scale over a slow 3s spring
manifesto paragraph that lights up word by word from 30% to full white as it scrolls
draggable project ticker of landscape cards with year and uppercase title set inside the image
numbered service ledger: title left, two-column tag grid and grey description right, hairline between rows, image trail following the cursor
giant cropped wordmark bleeding off the bottom of the footer
imagery: cinematic editorial photography (lone figure in landscape, dust cloud, styled portrait) in warm natural tones, used only inside 5px radius project cards and the hero
layout_grid: 1200 frame with 30px sides, 80px section padding, headers as title plus two-line intro left with a small white button right, content split 45/55, 5px radius, no shadows or borders except 1px white-10% row rules
